region_or_platform_notes: The OpenAI API still serves gpt-5.4-mini. Codex retired gpt-5.4-mini for ChatGPT sign-in on August 31, 2026. Codex sessions authenticated with an API key are not affected. The Codex models page says to replace gpt-5.4-mini with gpt-6-luna when it is available. In Enterprise and Edu, an administrator must enable Luna first.

sources.label: OpenAI model docs
sources.excerpt: Model ID: gpt-5.4-mini | Our strongest mini model yet for coding, computer use, and subagents

sources.label: Codex changelog
sources.excerpt: On August 31, 2026, GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will no longer be available in Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT. GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will remain available on the OpenAI API and Codex sessions authenticated with an API key.

sources.label: Codex models
sources.excerpt: The gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini models retired from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on August 31, 2026. Replace gpt-5.4-mini with gpt-6-luna when available to your plan and client. The OpenAI API and Codex authenticated with your own API key aren't affected by the GPT-5.4 retirement.
